name: Rename or retire a model
description: The two things about a model a competitor may change, and the one they may not. THE REPOSITORY IS IMMUTABLE because it is the key: a model that could move to another repository would be a different entry wearing this one's ratings and its whole match history. A name is a label and may be edited; `retired` is how a competitor puts a model down and is reversible, because it withdraws nothing that has already been played -- every version keeps its ratings and its seats, and the entry keeps its repository so retiring is not a way to restart a version series. A retired model takes no new releases and frees its slot under entries.max_per_user. Each field is coalesced against the stored value, which is what PATCH means. Ownership is in the statement, not beside it: the UPDATE names the caller's own row, so someone else's model is simply not found.

tasks.name: The repository, as one path
tasks.description: `{owner}/{repo}` is how the URL spells it and `owner/name` is how the column stores it. Joined here, once, rather than in each statement's WHERE -- and compared case-insensitively, because GitHub's namespace is.

input.query: UPDATE models e SET name = coalesce(btrim(($5)::text), e.name), retired_at = CASE WHEN ($6)::bool IS NULL THEN e.retired_at WHEN ($6)::bool THEN coalesce(e.retired_at, now()) ELSE NULL END FROM games g, live_sessions ls WHERE g.id = e.game_id AND g.slug = ($1)::text AND ls.sid = ($4)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($3)::uuid AND e.owner_id = ($3)::uuid AND lower(e.repo) = lower(($2)::text) AND (($5)::text IS NULL OR (btrim(($5)::text) <> '' AND length(btrim(($5)::text)) <= 64 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models o WHERE o.owner_id = e.owner_id AND o.game_id = e.game_id AND o.id <> e.id AND lower(o.name) = lower(btrim(($5)::text)))))

SELECT json_build_object('model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'name_taken', ($3)::text IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM models o WHERE o.owner_id = e.owner_id AND o.game_id = e.game_id AND o.id <> e.id AND lower(o.name) = lower(btrim(($3)::text)))) AS body FROM models e JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND lower(e.repo) = lower(($2)::text) AND e.owner_id = ($4)::uuid

SELECT json_build_object('model_id', e.id, 'model', e.name, 'repo', e.repo, 'game', g.slug, 'owner', u.handle, 'created_at', e.created_at, 'retired', e.retired_at IS NOT NULL, 'retired_at', e.retired_at) AS body FROM models e JOIN games g ON g.id = e.game_id JOIN users u ON u.id = e.owner_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND lower(e.repo) = lower(($2)::text) AND e.owner_id = ($3)::uuid
